newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares firm, boosted by Lek.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares firm, boosted by Lek.

text.p: Slovenian shares closed 0.38 percent higher on Thursday, pushed up by a three percent rise in market heavyweight Lek.
"Lek probably rose today in expectation of a dividend pay-out, said Mateja Gubanec, a broker at A bank.
Market direction depends on whether Slovenia ratifies the EU association accord, signed in June last year, brokers said.
* The SBI index added on 4.97 points to 1,322.37.
* Issue A of drug maker Lek was the most active, rising 3.02 percent to 24,900 tolars on volume of 576 shares for total turnover of 13.9 million tolars. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
